subject: Sprint Zero: Locking OKRs & QBR Runbook for FYQ1
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sprint Zero: Locking OKRs & QBR Runbook for FYQ1

Team —

Sprint zero is tomorrow; I want us to lock the high-level OKR set and the QBR runbook by EOD so the GTM packets can be produced on Wednesday. Key asks:

- Confirm owners for the three platform OKRs (Serving runtime, Dedicated capacity, Console observability).
- Sign off on the QBR runbook sections: metrics, escalation path, one-pager for partners.
- Approve the FYQ1 rollup that will be shared with execs.

I attached the draft runbook and an OKR rollup. Please review quickly and reply with one-line confirmations or clear asks. If you need changes, call out the exact line in the runbook.

I'll consolidate responses and publish the final artifacts at 4pm PT.

Thanks —
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
VP, Product Operations | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0172

Kimberly —

Thanks for the heads-up. Quick notes after a skim:

- Serving runtime OKR owner: propose we keep this with Research/Serving infra (I can take point for cross-org coordination) — please add "Markus (coord)" in the rollup.
- Dedicated capacity: need to clarify the "burst" SLA language in the runbook; suggest adding a fallback paragraph calling out Dedicated->Hosted routing in congestion.
- Console observability: add one metric for token-level cost variance (weekly).

I'll inline the minor wording change to the runbook and upload a v1.1 by noon. Everything else looks fine from my side.

-Markus
